main.description: One period of study. NOTE: check lexicon.garden for an existing education record under id.sifa.* before adopting this -- if Sifa defines one, use theirs and drop this file. It is defined here only because degree, thesis, and advisor fields have no equivalent in a generic employment-position record. Dates use the id.sifa.* freeform shape (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD) for cross-namespace compatibility.

degree.description: Structured degree level. 'postdoctoral' lives here rather than in employment because many CVs list it under education, and a dossier can route it either way.

degreeName.description: Degree as awarded and as it must be printed, e.g. '博士(工学)', 'Ph.D. in Computer Science'. Not derivable from `degree`.

endedAt.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Required context when status is not 'inProgress'.

status.description: 'creditsCompletedNoDegree' exists because 単位取得退学 is a standard and non-pejorative outcome in Japan that no international schema represents.

thesisRef.description: StrongRef to a pub.paper.reference record for the thesis, when it has been deposited.
